title: Rethinking LoRA Initialization for Robust Asymmetric Learning Rates
abstract: arXiv:2610.32142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain competitive with many proposed LoRA variants. This shifts the central practical question from designing ever more variants to reducing the cost and brittleness of LR selection. LoRA+ addresses this issue with asymmetric LRs, using a larger LR for the up-projection matrix $B$ than for the down-projection matrix $A$. However, the ratio $\eta_B / \eta_A$ itself becomes an additional hyperparameter: large ratios can improve adaptation, but under the standard LoRA initialization they can also cause unstable training and ratio-dependent performance collapse. We identify the source of this brittleness through a signal--noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics. translated_title: 重新思考 LoRA 初始化以实现稳健的非对称学习率
translated_abstract: 低秩适应方法对学习率（LR）的选择往往非常敏感。近期的实证研究表明，一旦学习率经过仔细调优，原始的 LoRA 仍然可以与许多已提出的 LoRA 变体保持竞争力。这将核心的实际问题从设计更多变体转变为降低学习率选择的成本和脆弱性。LoRA+ 通过非对称学习率解决了这一问题，对上投影矩阵 $B$ 使用比下投影矩阵 $A$ 更大的学习率。然而，比率 $\eta_B / \eta_A$ 本身成为一个额外的超参数：较大的比率可以改善适配效果，但在标准 LoRA 初始化下，它们也可能导致训练不稳定以及依赖比率的性能崩溃。我们通过对 LoRA 动力学的信号-噪声分解来识别这种脆弱性的来源。在标准初始化下，更新中包含一个由初始化引起的噪声项，其大小可能受到……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对 LoRA 动力学的信号-噪声分解，揭示了标准初始化下由初始化引起的噪声项是非对称学习率训练不稳定和性能崩溃的根源，从而主张重新设计 LoRA 初始化以实现稳健的非对称学习率。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies, via a signal-noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics, that the initialization-induced noise term under standard LoRA initialization is the source of training instability and ratio-dependent performance collapse with asymmetric learning rates, motivating a rethinking of LoRA initialization for robust asymmetric learning rates.
